title: Broken Link Fixes
meta: Find broken links and bad redirects across your store and fix them, so visitors and search engines land on a real page. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Broken link fixes that protect your traffic
overview: Broken links send shoppers to error pages and waste visits from search and ads. We scan your store for links that lead nowhere, both on your own pages and in menus, emails and old product pages. We then fix each one, by correcting the link or by adding a redirect to the closest useful page. You receive a list showing every problem, where it was and how it was fixed, with a final scan to prove it.

faq: Where do broken links come from?
Mostly from deleted products, renamed collections, changed addresses and links to other sites that have moved. They build up quietly as a store grows and changes.
No. A single redirect is quick. We remove long chains of redirects, which are the part that can slow a page and confuse search engines.
Do you fix links on other sites that point to me?
We set up redirects for those addresses so visitors still arrive. We cannot edit another site, but we can note the important ones for you to contact.
Does the scan cover links in emails and ads?
We check links on your store. If you share your email and ad links in a list, we test those too and tell you which ones fail.
